summary: Removes all States and Ongoing Effects (caster may leave some) from a player within 20', including a dead player.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: All Ongoing Effects and States; the caster may choose to leave some in place (E2). Polarity is 'benefit' for the usual use (freeing an ally); it can also strip beneficial States from a foe.

effects.subject: dead-target
effects.note: Greater Release may target Dead players.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Only the other States and Ongoing Effects from the same source, when the one removed was imposed by an ability with multiple effects; the caster cannot keep one effect of such a source while removing another (E2).

properties.note: Caster may choose to leave some States or Effects in place.
Literal reading: 'All ... States' includes Cursed; the text does not name Cursed.

clarifications.text: Caster may choose to leave some States or Ongoing Effects in place.
Greater Release may target dead players.
Ending a State or Ongoing Effect from an ability with multiple effects also ends all other States and Ongoing Effects from that same source.

open_questions: E1 says 'All ... States' without excepting Cursed (Release's L1 explicitly cannot remove Cursed); recorded bypass-cursed on the literal reading.
